title: The Ordinary Wardrobe
author: Juniper Coldharbour
blurb: Freya Okonkwo, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
